capability.title: Compose Image Prompts — Room & Interior
capability.summary: Bound by home_goods. Interiors fail on spatial logic long before they fail on style: wrong scale, impossible geometry and inconsistent light kill a frame that is otherwise beautiful.

compose.system_append:
SPATIAL DISCIPLINE
- Name the room type, its approximate dimensions and the window direction. Hold all three constant across the set.
- Every piece of furniture sits flat on the floor with a contact shadow. Floating furniture is the single most common failure in this category.
- Include one human-scale reference per frame (a door, a mug, a standing person out of focus).
- Shadow direction must agree with the stated window direction in every frame.
- For before/after pairs, describe the identical room, identical camera position and identical light — change only what the product changes.
